final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT l.ID AS id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS c3, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS c4 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT sex, AVG(c3) AS c2, AVG(c4) AS c3 FROM s1 GROUP BY sex), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS c1 FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.sex AS c1, s2.c2 AS c2, s2.c3 AS c3, s2.c3 - s3.c1 AS c4 FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.c3 > s3.c1) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s4
